How many uplights do I need?
It depends on the length of the walls, the ceiling height and how even you want the color. Send a floor plan or a few photos of the space and we will count them.
Can uplighting match our brand colors?
Yes. Send the brand colors and we set the lights to match, and the color can change during the event.
Do you set up and take down the uplights?
Yes. Our crew places and focuses every light before guests arrive and packs it up at the end.
Can I rent uplighting with sound and a stage?
Yes. Speakers, microphones, stage decks and screens come from the same crew, planned with the lighting and billed on one quote.
It depends on how many lights, the hours and whether an operator stays. Send the space and the date and we reply with an itemized quote.
